about.title: About Kibbo's Auto Center
about.text: Kibbo's Auto Center & Entertainment is St. Catherine's trusted destination for quality pre-owned vehicles and automotive services. Located in McCooks Pen, we offer a wide selection of cars, trucks, and SUVs at competitive prices. Beyond the auto center, we also bring you entertainment — making us a true community hub. Visit us today and drive away happy!
